title: cyphostemma luteum
intro: Cyphostemma luteum, commonly known as the 'Yellow Bottle Plant', is a succulent species belonging to the family Vitaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits, including reducing inflammation and alleviating symptoms of anxiety and stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
